title: Concrete section-normalized native inverse-pushforward translation
statement: Let Y be any scheme, l prime and g:Y≅Y. Use the fixed ordinary small-site model, ring and translation [def-sf-native-frobenius-model-data], and the section counit e [lem-sf-native-frobenius-hom-evaluation]. The first pullback projection gives a natural isomorphism alpha from base change along g.inv to postcomposition along g. There is a natural isomorphism c:E.functor ⋙ adicLowerStar(l,g.inv) ≅ S ⋙ E.functor such that for every ordinary module M, pro-etale object V and section z of inverse pushforward of E(M), e_SM(c_M(z)) equals e_M applied at postcomposition(V) to restriction of z along alpha_V inverse. The construction uses no unproved existence witness.

proof.text: Use the first pullback projection as the component of alpha. It is an isomorphism since g.inv is. Its structure-map identity is the pullback square followed by g.inv_hom_id; naturality is pullback.lift_fst.

proof.text: Restriction along alpha inverse is additive. The native section scalar action is the module action on a pure coefficient-module tensor. Lax monoidal compatibility of sheaf pushforward with sheaf-to-presheaf shows that the pushforward action restricts scalars along adicConstantSheafToLowerStar. Restricting along alpha inverse cancels this map by the presheaf inverse identity, proving linearity. Naturality follows by the pullback naturality square. On the small site the identity-ring-map postcomposition functor is definitionally the specified translation.

proof.text: Conjugate the section isomorphism by the fixed section counit and lift through the fully faithful native section-module functor. Applying the functor to its preimage recovers the conjugated isomorphism. Cancel the target counit inverse on sections to get the claimed normalization.

theorem nativeFrobeniusSectionTransport (Y : Scheme.{u}) (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (g : Y ≅ Y) :
    let _ := (translation_continuous Y g).1
    let _ := (translation_continuous Y g).2
    ∃ c : (equivalence Y l).functor ⋙ adicLowerStar l g.inv ≅
        sigma (topology Y) (translation g) (ring Y l) (ringIso Y l g) ⋙
          (equivalence Y l).functor,
      ∀ (M : Modules (ring Y l)) (V : Y.ProEtᵒᵖ)
        (z : ((adicLowerStar l g.inv).obj ((equivalence Y l).functor.obj M)).X.obj.obj V),
      ((sectionCounit Y l).hom.app
        ((sigma (topology Y) (translation g) (ring Y l) (ringIso Y l g)).obj M)).val.app V
          ((c.hom.app M).hom.hom.app V z) =
      ((sectionCounit Y l).hom.app M).val.app ((postcompose g).functor.op.obj V)
        (((equivalence Y l).functor.obj M).X.obj.map
          ((pullbackPostcomposeIso Y g).inv.app V.unop).op z)
